property_summary: For any admissible (account, id), c.balanceOf(account, id) must report the actual stored token balance, which is zero for any account that has never been minted tokens via c's (inaccessible-in-test) mint path; the mutant returns stored+1 and thus reports 1 instead of 0.
change_summary: Change the returned balance to be one greater than the stored balance.
